item.title: CalcStat (2.5.7)
item.description:
Version: 2.5.7
Author: Giseldah
Category: LotRO Libraries
Updated: 2026-11-22 08:43 UTC
Downloads: 685,547
File: CalcStat_2_5_7.zip (179.0 KB)

This package adds stat calculation support to plugins and provides the plugin CalcStatExpressions so users can make stat queries and calculations themselves.

Calculation examples are:
1 all what is needed for Rating to Percentage or vice versa calculations
2 item stat calculations based on item level
3 skill/effect stat calculations based on player level
4 virtue stat calculations based on rank including required xp

I created CalcStat initially for my LotroPlan spreadsheetRIP but Ive expanded it and made it more flexible so it can be used in many other types of applications...

GUI Giseldahs UI

A Layout Management Library for
Lord of the Rings Online Plugins

GUI brings CSS Flexbox & Box Model features to Lotro plugins:
flexible autosizing & positioning of controls with Flexbox
margin / border / padding frames around embedded controls.
colored borders of any size.
graphical borders build from images.
